text: {"lessons":["Selling some shares after a strong gain can lock in profits, but I should avoid selling solely for the satisfaction of realizing a gain.","Doing nothing through several declining periods let my account value fall; I should review whether each holding still fits my plan rather than avoid decisions out of regret.","I check my account often and feel losses keenly, so I should use clear rules for buying, holding, and selling instead of reacting emotionally to daily price moves."]}
